verdict.rationale: FireHydrant's docs say it integrates with alerting and monitoring tools to create incidents from alerts and can alert on events from any monitoring tool, so a first-party monitoring-integration capability exists. However, the evidence never names Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, CloudWatch or Sentry, and shows no per-tool setup guides. The generic webhook event source is a building block and earns no credit. missing for 10: named first-party integrations for Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, CloudWatch and Sentry, documented setup guides for each, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, first-party integrations cover my observability stack — Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, CloudWatch, Sentry — with documented setup

citations.quote: Integrate with alerting and monitoring integrations to automatically create incidents from alerts
Alert and page your responders about events coming from any monitoring tool
